bio.text: Raghib Allie-Brennan represents Connecticut's 2nd House District, which includes Bethel and parts of Danbury, and is the House Chief Majority Whip.
Born in Queens, New York, and raised in Bethel, he graduated from Bethel High School in 2009 and earned a B.A. in International Studies from Marymount Manhattan College in 2013.
Earlier in his career he was a congressional policy advisor in the U.S. House of Representatives.
He previously served as Deputy Majority Leader (2023-2024), Assistant Majority Whip (2021-2022) and Assistant Majority Leader (2019-2020).
